meta.title: OneShot Interactive Demo Scenarios
meta.note: All workflow events, task IDs, findings, and tool results in this demo are deterministic simulated fixtures rendered by demo.js in the browser. No real OneShot backend is called by the demo page. Real-backend evidence is stored separately under screenshots/reference/ (captured from the live app on http://127.0.0.1:8000).

scenarios.title: OneShot startup and System Chat
scenarios.initialState: Clean reset: empty transcript with OneShot empty state, no task, MCP disconnected.

actions.expected: Empty state 'What should OneShot look into?' is visible
Composer contains the typed audit request and Send enables

args.text: Audit the agent package for security issues and plan the fixes

actions.expected: Capability switches from Research to Audit
User message appears, host creates task a3f9c1e8…, Task Summary populates
Task ID a3f9c1e8… is visible in Task Summary
Research request typed into System Chat composer

args.text: Research the OneShot repository: map the agent package, providers, and host gates

actions.expected: Capability is Research
Task created; execution shows awaiting_mcp; input artifact persisted rev 1
Host message confirms frozen input and next action; task_created event in Evidence Stream
'Run Research' action is available
Review artifact modal opens showing the editable task input
Run Research action is enabled for the created task
Researcher worker shows typing indicator, then streams evidence with findings chips
actions.fixture: 4 evidence findings: providers.py, host.py, tools.py, config.yaml

actions.expected: research_evidence events appear in Evidence Stream with sequence numbers
Execution shows research_completed
task_research.json opens read-only with evidence and acceptance criteria
Artifact modal closes, transcript focused
Follow-up audit request typed; purpose set to Audit

args.text: Now audit the agent package read-only and record CodeIntent candidates

actions.expected: User follow-up message appears in transcript
Audit worker inspects agent/providers.py, agent/host.py, agent/tools.py with severity findings
actions.fixture: 3 findings: high shell execution, medium secret handling, low error detail

actions.expected: Audit stage chip turns done; audit_completed event recorded
task_audit.json opens with findings and CodeIntent candidates
Modal closes; findings remain visible in transcript
Planner message: converting audit CodeIntent into a BuildSpecification
PLAN TODOs panel appears in Task Summary with 4 pending items
actions.fixture: TODO-1..4: sandbox tool identity, secret redaction, digest pinning, completed_at ordering

actions.expected: TODO-1 in-progress, then TODO-1 and TODO-2 complete with check transitions
Host message: BuildSpec drafted and frozen by host (Planner cannot freeze)
build_spec.json opens with 4 admitted candidate actions and acceptance checks
Modal closes; Planning stage done
Fixture Validator starts independent checks against the frozen spec
Validation REJECTED: TODO-3 tool digest missing from ToolRegistrySnapshot; warning banner and failed stage chip
actions.fixture: fixture_report.json verdict rejected — missing provenance is a blocker

actions.expected: fixture_report.json shows the rejection reason and required correction
Modal closes; correction action offered
Planner pins digest sha256:9f2c…e41a from host snapshot; build_spec.json rev 2; TODO-3 unblocked
Re-validation PASSED; validation stage done; correction event in Evidence Stream

scenarios.title: Build Admission and authorization
scenarios.initialState: Fixture validation passed; build not yet admitted.

actions.expected: Host evaluates admission gates: authorization, digests, sandbox profile (default-deny)
Builder direct run attempt denied — arbitrary tool strings do not grant execution
Host admits 4 actions from the frozen spec; admitted tool IDs derived by host only
admission_receipt.json lists admitted actions, tool IDs, sandbox profile, authorization gate pass
Modal closes; 'Run Build' enabled
Build starts; worker announces execution; progress bar appears at 0%
TODO-1 executing: host rechecks tool identity + digest before sandbox run; progress 25%
TODO-2 executing: secret redaction check; progress 50%
TODO-3 executing: pinned digest verified sha256:9f2c…e41a; progress 75%
TODO-4 executing: completed_at ordering fix; progress 92%
build_result.json persisted; Build stage done; execution build_completed
build_result.json shows 4/4 actions succeeded with tool receipts
Modal closes; progress 100%

scenarios.title: MCP/API connection and error handling
scenarios.initialState: Task exists; MCP and Model both show disconnected.

actions.expected: Connection settings dialog opens with MCP CONNECTION and MODEL API CONFIGURATION sections (SIMULATED)
Invalid MCP server URL entered: https://mcp.example.invalid/mcp with Authentication type None
MCP test failed message and connector error appear; discovered tools stay empty
MCP server URL corrected to http://127.0.0.1:9234/mcp for the supported HTTP transport
MCP test passed: 2 tools discovered — oneshot_research and source_lookup — and the MCP status becomes connected
MCP connected: 2 tools discovered; the topbar MCP status changes to MCP connected
Model API fields are completed with the demo base URL and model ID; the password field is intentionally left empty
Model test passed: provider-ready; Provider response: provider-ready appears and the secret field is cleared
Model settings saved; Saved values shows demo-model and the base URL while the dialog remains open for review
Build attempt re-running; TODO-1 and TODO-2 complete; progress 50%
Sandbox worker disconnects mid-TODO-3; progress bar failed; error banner; execution interrupted
Execution status shows interrupted
Host recovery message: checkpoint persisted for TODO-1/2; TODO-3 safe to resume; no partial effects
Resume requested; host re-verifies admission and checkpoint before resuming
TODO-3 resumes and completes; TODO-4 completes; progress 100%
Execution shows build_completed after recovery

scenarios.title: Independent verification
scenarios.initialState: Build completed; verifier independent of builder.

actions.expected: Build Verifier starts real E2E checks against acceptance criteria (no self-certification)
Checks stream in: sandbox argv without shell ✓, digest recheck ✓, secret redaction ✓
One check flagged: event ordering assertion pending re-run; verifier requests fresh observation
Ordered event replay re-run passes; all 6 acceptance criteria green
verification_report.json shows 6/6 criteria passed with independent observations
Modal closes; Verification stage done
Completion message: workflow complete, 8/8 stage chips done, artifact snapshot listed
task_summary.json opens: final overview of task, stages, artifacts, verification verdict
Modal closes
Hover highlights the artifact panel; the latest 8 of 9 artifact rows are visible (panel cap) and the summary artifact is present
Final state: execution completed_verified, all stages done — observable completion
